verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state you can 'Turn a Figma frame into a working app' and 'Begin from a website you already own and refine it in the app editor,' directly matching the story, but this is a first-party marketing/quickstart claim with no independent hands-on corroboration or detail on fidelity of import. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of Figma import quality, technical detail on what parts of a Figma design are faithfully translated, and any hands-on report confirming the feature works as described.
